column1: # guarantees dual OTA app slots (~1.81MB each) and fixes a 320KB LittleFS
# budget that fits the built UI (~140 KiB today) plus /config.bin; keeping the
# whole table stable from the start avoids a second partition-migration flash.
# WARNING (flash layout): the first USB `pio run -e faraday -t upload` rewrites
# the partition table and invalidates existing LittleFS contents (/config.bin).
# After that first flash the device reboots into the default AP
# OTA (`-t upload` over espota) cannot migrate the partition layout: switching
# to this table requires exactly one USB flash. Subsequent OTA updates work
# normally. Changing the table later repeats the same one-USB-flash +
